correctness.rationale: For arbitrary k>=2, positive m_i, and alpha in [0,1], a weighted Hilbert variance identity with strictly positive weights produces a universal lower bound C²>=r/2-1/S. Orthogonal centered regular simplices and block-centre vectors explicitly attain it, with a perpendicular hub coordinate exactly in the isometric regime. Equality for R²>1 fixes all pairwise distances and yields congruence. An exact quadratic form proves leaf affine rank N-1 and the hub rank transition. Strict monotonicity and both endpoint cases prove uniqueness of the threshold. The standalone rational checker passed 585 cases and 72300 assertions; finite checks are not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The natural class of all one-hub clique bouquets includes stars, friendship graphs and nonuniform clique blocks. The exact harmonic distortion invariant is nontrivial and supplies a complete continuous snowflake threshold, full congruence rigidity, and a discontinuous least affine dimension at the sharp threshold. This is an informative natural graph-embedding classification, not a parameter-table recomputation or arbitrary small case.
